verdict.rationale: Postman exposes a REST API for programmatically managing collections/environments and a CLI that can run governance checks and test collections in CI/CD, which supports some CI-driven synchronization of API assets, but there is no evidence of true declarative infrastructure-as-code (e.g., YAML/Terraform-style config) for gateway/traffic rules or automated GitOps reconciliation loops. missing for 10: declarative config format for gateway/traffic infra, GitOps controller/reconciliation, evidence of managing routing/rate-limit rules as code, independent case studies of CI-driven infra sync.
